projectTitle: Check before you pay (Bittensor registration outcomes)
description: Before you pay a Bittensor subnet's registration fee, see what happened to the entries that paid it: how many still earn after one and two weeks, how many got the fee back, and what a new entry is paid today. Measured from the chain, free to read, with no key and no account.
rules: The figures change every day, so fetch the live file of the subnet before quoting a number, for example https://check.loopholetape.com/c/31.md for subnet 31, and say the date it was read up to.
The figures count the registration fee only and are measurements of what happened, not predictions.
